newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-MAN UTD FAVOURITES FOR NEXT SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MAN UTD FAVOURITES FOR NEXT SEASON.

text.p: English champions Manchester United were installed as 11-8 favourites on Monday to retain their title next season.
Bookmakers William Hill made Liverpool and Newcastle joint second favourites at 4-1 with Arsenal 9-2 and Chelsea 14-1.
Barnsley, promoted to the top flight this season for the first time in their history, were 1,000-1 to win the championship at the first attempt.
